mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: unsupported wish: a wish for gold

summary: At step 162, the wizard wish prompt submits `blessed 30 gold pieces`. C's objnam.c readobjnam() gold arm clamps the count, calls mksobj(GOLD_PIECE, FALSE, FALSE), sets the quantity and weight, marks the status line dirty, and returns the object; JS readobjnam_postparse1() raises UnsupportedWishError before that branch, which failClosedCommand wraps as the observed hero-command boundary. Port this missing readobjnam arm through the existing makewish() and inventory path while retaining C's count rules and RNG order.

source.branch: nethack-c/upstream/src/objnam.c:4533-4545 is reached after the normal readobjnam parsing chain when d->bp ends in `gold piece` or `zorkmid`, equals `gold`, `money` or `coin`, or begins with GOLD_SYM. In this debug wizard recording d->cnt is 30, so the non-wizard >5000 cap and the minimum-count correction do not change it. C then calls mksobj(GOLD_PIECE, FALSE, FALSE), assigns d->otmp->quan = d->cnt, recomputes d->otmp->owt with weight(), sets disp.botl, and returns the object directly. The JavaScript split of this C function reaches js/objnam_readobjnam.js:1064-1069 inside readobjnam_postparse1(), where it currently raises UnsupportedWishError before mksobj(); js/objnam_readobjnam.js:1570-1612 supplies the readobjnam() driver and return-code path.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:makewish() (6314-6422) calls readobjnam(buf, &nothing) at 6360; js/zap.js:makewish() (999-1122) calls readobjnam() at 1055 and then hands the returned object to hold_another_object().

nethack-c/upstream/src/wizcmds.c:wiz_wish() (31-44) calls makewish() for the wizard #wizwish command; js/wizcmds.js:wiz_wish() (141-160) is its production counterpart, and js/cmd.js:runWishCommand() (3424-3429) plus the wizwish dispatch (5122-5124, 5900-5911) route the session into it.

Other source callers share makewish() and therefore this readobjnam branch: nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:WAN_WISHING (2575-2584), potion.c:mongrantswish() (2794-2812), sit.c:special_throne_effect() (90-111, 238-256), and allmain.c resume/Amulet paths (200-202, 445-451); js/potion.js:mongrantswish() (190-211) and js/allmain.js:advanceElapsedTurn() (1314-1328) supply the corresponding existing call sites where ported.
dependencies: nethack-c/upstream/src/mkobj.c:mksobj() (1177-1258) advances next_ident(), creates the GOLD_PIECE object with init false, and finalizes its weight; js/obj.js:mksobj() (2631-2695) already supports the same init=false path, including GOLD_PIECE's ordinary finalization.
nethack-c/upstream/src/mkobj.c:weight() (1888-1945) computes a coin object's weight; js/obj.js:weight() (1682-1730) has the COIN_CLASS result and must be called after setting quan, as C does.

nethack-c/upstream/src/invent.c:hold_another_object() (1208-1306) receives the returned stack and emits the inventory/drop result; js/invent.js:hold_another_object() (4810-4903) is the existing production path that js/zap.js:makewish() prepares and calls.

nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:makewish() (6359-6421) continues after readobjnam(), ultimately adding rn1(100, 50) to u.ublesscnt; js/zap.js:makewish() (1055-1122) mirrors that tail. The recorded step-162 RNG has rnd(2)=2 at next_ident(mkobj.c:521), followed by rn2(100)=17 at makewish(zap.c:6421), so the new arm must preserve both draws and their order.

js/cmd.js:failClosedCommand() (3017-3029) converts UnsupportedWishError into the observed `unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: ...` boundary; removing only the gold refusal must leave other explicitly unsupported wish branches intact.
